name: smwgraphics-mega-man-x-prototype-weapons-plant
title: Mega Man X - Prototype Weapons Plant
description:
Here's a large portion of the FG rip on Flame Mammoth's level. Only some tiles had to be left out but most are included.

Comes with 3 ExGFX files and uses 2 palette rows. Info for exanimation also included.

Credit would be nice but it isn't required.
